# AGENTS.md

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

SIM-MNI: Laravel 13 service exposing an `X-API-Token` REST API over tribunal MNI (PJe) SOAP webservices, plus an Inertia/React admin UI. Domain language and identifiers are pt-BR.

## 1. Build, Lint, Test and Coverage

Host has no PHP. Run PHP/Composer inside the docker-compose `php` service; `./php` and `./composer` wrap `docker compose exec -u composer php {php|composer}`.

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `composer test` | `artisan config:clear` + `artisan test` (Pest); run inside container |
| `docker compose exec -T php php artisan test --compact` | Run Pest suite from host |
| `./php artisan test` | Run Pest suite via host wrapper |
| `npm run typecheck` | `tsc --noEmit` (strict TypeScript) |
| `npm run build` | `vite build` |
| `composer dev` | concurrently: `artisan serve`, `queue:listen --tries=1`, `pail --timeout=0`, `npm run dev`; run inside container |
| `./build.sh` | In container `$CONTAINER_NAME`: `composer install`, `migrate --force`, `cache:clear`, `route:clear`, `npm install`, `npm run build` |
| `./build-prod-local.sh [tag]` | Build `docker/prod/8.4/Dockerfile`; default tag `sim-mni:prod-local` |
| `docker build -f ./docker/Dockerfile.aws.prod -t vendor/sim-mni . --no-cache` | Build AWS ECR/ECS image (`ecr-push.sh`) |

- Test runner: Pest 5 on PHPUnit 13; suites `tests/Unit`, `tests/Feature` (`phpunit.xml`).
- Test DB: connection from `.env` (sqlite lines commented in `phpunit.xml`); isolation via `DatabaseTransactions` (`RefreshDatabase` commented in `tests/Pest.php`).
- Test env overrides (`phpunit.xml`): `QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync`, `CACHE_STORE=array`, `SESSION_DRIVER=array`, `MAIL_MAILER=array`, `PULSE_ENABLED=false`, `BCRYPT_ROUNDS=4`.
- PHP lint/format: none wired. `laravel/pint` is a dev dependency with no script, `pint.json`, or CI step.
- Coverage: none configured. `phpunit.xml` `<source>` includes `app/`, no report target.
- CI: `.github/workflows/deploy-production.yaml` only calls the Coolify webhook on push to `main`. No test/lint/build gate; run `composer test` and `npm run typecheck` before pushing.

## 2. Code Style & Project Conventions

| Rule | Enforcement |
|---|---|
| PHP style = Laravel preset; `no_unused_imports` disabled; `index.php` excluded | `.styleci.yml` |
| JS and CSS also style-checked | `.styleci.yml` (`js: true`, `css: true`) |
| UTF-8, LF, 4-space indent; YAML 2 spaces; `docker-compose.yml` 4 spaces | `.editorconfig` |
| TypeScript strict; import alias `@/*` → `resources/js/*` | `tsconfig.json`, `npm run typecheck` |
| UI primitives = shadcn/ui `new-york` in `resources/js/components/ui` | `components.json` |
| Every queue name maps to a Horizon supervisor: `alta`, `default`, `mni-download`, `exportar-processo`, `monitoramento`, `monitoramento-webhook` | `config/horizon.php` |

- Domain names, identifiers, and messages in pt-BR (`Processo`, `Monitoramento`, `Exportacao`, `CredencialPje`).
- Business logic in `app/Services/` (MNI, Processo, Monitoramento, Exportacao, Callback, Dashboard, ComunicacaoPJe).
- REST controllers in `app/Http/Controllers/Api/`; Inertia web controllers in `app/Http/Controllers/`; React pages in `resources/js/pages/`.
- Validation via FormRequests in `app/Http/Requests/Api/`; serialization via `app/Http/Resources/`.
- MNI SOAP calls go through `app/Services/IntegracaoBase.php` + `app/Services/SoapClientMNI.php`; operations in `app/Services/MNI/Intercomunicacao/`.
- MNI/PJe errors → `MNIException`; constructor standardizes text via `PadronizarMensagemMniService` `REGRAS` (ordered substring table).
- External API auth = `X-API-Token` header (`ValidateApiToken`); `auth:sanctum` only on `GET /api/user`.
- Outbound webhooks via `app/Services/Callback/CallbackNotifier.php`; callback URLs validated by `app/Rules/CallbackUrl.php`.
- Tests: Pest `expect()`; `Queue::fake`, `Http::fake`, `Storage::fake`, `mock()`; helpers `criarTokenApi()`, `definirCredenciaisPadrao()` in `tests/Pest.php`; factories in `database/factories/`.
- Full guide: [docs/agents/coding_guidelines.md](docs/agents/coding_guidelines.md).

## 3. Agent Communication & Behavioral Guidelines

- Run PHP, Composer, and artisan through the `php` compose service; host `php` does not exist.
- Keep new domain identifiers and user-facing messages in pt-BR, matching existing code.
- Change `routes/api.php` → update `docs/api/openapi.yaml` (served at `/docs/api`) in the same change.

### Never in this repository

- Never raise `maxProcesses` above 1 for `supervisor-monitoramento`; serial by design, tribunal queried one process at a time (`config/horizon.php`, README).
- Never return PJe credentials from the API; expose only `login_mascarado`, store `encrypted` in `credenciais_pje` (README).
- Never attach `InjectCredenciaisPjePadrao` to `/processo/monitoramentos` routes (`routes/api.php`).
- Never add queue retries to `ExecutarMonitoramentoProcessoJob` (`tries 1`); `monitoramentos:despachar` owns rescheduling.
- Never rotate `APP_KEY` without re-collecting credentials; rotation invalidates saved `credenciais_pje` (README).

## 4. Setup, Troubleshooting and Tips

Prereqs: Docker + Compose, external Docker network `desenvolvimento`, Node 22 for `npm` scripts. PHP 8.5 + Composer 2 live in the `php` container.

```sh
docker-compose up -d
./composer install
./php artisan key:generate
./php artisan migrate:fresh --seed
```

- Dev container (`docker/supervisord/supervisord.conf`) runs FrankenPHP on `:80`, `schedule:work`, `horizon`, `pulse:check`; host port `${CONTAINER_PORT:-8001}`.
- Compose services: `redis` 7.4.0, `postgres` `pgvector/pgvector:pg18` (db `ms_mni`, host port 5435).
- `docker/postgres/init/01-restore-dumps.sh` restores `docker/postgres/dumps/*.sql` on first start.
- Project env: `PJE_LOGIN_PADRAO` / `PJE_SENHA_PADRAO` (default PJe pair), `HORIZON_ADMIN_EMAILS` (Horizon gate), `AWS_*` (S3 disk for documents/exports).
- Env read by config but missing from `.env.example`: `DB_HOST`, `DB_PORT`, `DB_DATABASE`, `DB_USERNAME`, `DB_PASSWORD`, `AWS_URL`, `AWS_ENDPOINT`, `OCTANE_SERVER`, `PJE_MONITORAMENTO_MAX_ATIVOS_POR_TOKEN`, `CONTAINER_NAME`, `CONTAINER_PORT`, `REDIS_FORWARD_PORT`, `DB_FORWARD_PORT`.
- Fallbacks: `DB_CONNECTION` → `sqlite` (`config/database.php`); `QUEUE_CONNECTION` → `database` (`config/queue.php`); Horizon supervisors use `redis`.
- Preview API docs: `npx @redocly/cli preview-docs docs/api/openapi.yaml`.
- Prod: Octane + FrankenPHP (`docker/prod/8.4/`, php8.5 images despite path); `config/octane.php` default `roadrunner`, overridden by `--server=frankenphp`.
- Deploy: push to `main` → Coolify webhook. AWS path: `ecr-push.sh`, `ecs-service-deploy.sh` (`sa-east-1`, cluster `SIM-Cluster`, service `sim-mni`).

Ops artisan commands (run via `./php artisan <command>`):

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `monitoramentos:despachar` | Enqueue due monitoramentos; scheduled every 30 min, `withoutOverlapping` |
| `monitoramentos:reenviar-webhook {execucao_id?} --reset-tentativas --force` | Re-dispatch pending monitoring callbacks |
| `monitoramentos:limpar-execucoes --dias=90` | Prune execution history; scheduled 04:30 |
| `exportacoes:reenviar-webhook {exportacao_id?} --reset-tentativas --force` | Re-dispatch export callbacks |
| `media:check` / `media:fix-inconsistent` / `media:redownload --batch=50` | Inspect, fix, re-download document binaries (S3) |
| `app:clean-temp --hours=24` | Clean temp files |
| `app:clean-duplicate-failed-jobs --dry-run` | Remove duplicate failed jobs |

| Symptom | Check |
|---|---|
| `php: command not found` on host | Use `./php artisan ...` or `docker compose exec -T php php ...` |
| `docker-compose up` fails on network | External network `desenvolvimento` exists |
| HTTP 500 on `/pulse` | Logged in; Pulse migrations run; `top` (`procps`) in container (`docs/pulse-troubleshooting.md`) |
| Tests touch dev data | `phpunit.xml` sqlite lines commented; tests use `.env` connection inside `DatabaseTransactions` |
| Saved PJe credentials fail after deploy | `APP_KEY` rotated → re-`POST /api/processo/monitoramentos` (upsert) with credentials |
| Monitoramento stuck `suspenso` | `falhas_consecutivas` reached `max_falhas_consecutivas` 5 (`config/pje.php`); new credential via `POST`/`PATCH` resets it |
| Scheduler errors for `mni:consultar-orgao` / `cnj:consultar-classes` | Scheduled in `routes/console.php`; no matching `$signature` in `app/Console/Commands/` |
| Job on new queue never runs | Queue listed in a `config/horizon.php` supervisor |
